description: Connectable Design with AI catalogue cards exported from AI-EFFECT staging on 2026-11-25. Frozen so results stay comparable across models.

cards.name: Pipeline Config
cards.purpose: Imported from Full Use Case: Fetch, Prepare, Train, Generate, Features, Benchmark

cards.name: benchmark-runner / RunBenchmark
cards.purpose: Runs a reproducible benchmark of AI/control approaches on a prepared grid scenario and reports KPIs.
cards.use_when: After a synthetic grid scenario has been prepared.

cards.name: config_assistant1 / BuildRunConfig
cards.purpose: Turns a plain-language district-heating request into a structured run configuration (Danish node, uses a local language model).
cards.use_when: Start of a district-heating network design workflow; before topology generation.

how_many.title: Maximum topologies
how_many.description: Upper limit; fewer are returned when fewer are feasible.

cards.name: data_generator1 / GenerateData
cards.purpose: Generates data records for a downstream analysis step (synthetic data from a trained model, or simulated energy readings).
cards.use_when: After model training or configuration; before analysis or reporting.

cards.name: data_loader1 / ExecuteQuery
cards.purpose: Loads energy data from a CSV file or a database query (Portuguese node) as the starting dataset.
cards.use_when: Start of the Portuguese synthetic-data workflow.

rename_columns.title: Rename columns
rename_columns.description: Map of old column name to new name.

cards.name: data_provider1 / ProvideData
cards.purpose: Prepares German grid and time-series data for generating load and generation profiles.
cards.use_when: Start of a German time-series (chronics) workflow.

cards.name: draw_topology1 / RenderTopologies
cards.purpose: Draws generated network topologies as SVG images for review.
cards.use_when: End of a district-heating workflow, to visualise candidate networks.

cards.name: feature_engineer1 / ApplyFunction
cards.purpose: Applies feature-engineering functions from a knowledge store to prepare data for model training.
cards.use_when: After loading data and before training a model.

cards.name: grid_synth_service / ConfigureAndSynthesize
cards.purpose: Creates a reproducible synthetic electricity grid scenario (Dutch node) for benchmarking.
cards.use_when: Start of a grid benchmarking workflow when real grid data is not available.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Same seed gives the same synthetic grid.

loading_level.title: Loading level
loading_level.description: Low, medium or high grid loading.

cards.name: model_trainer1 / TrainModel
cards.purpose: Trains a DoppelGANger (DGAN) generative model on prepared time-series data.
cards.use_when: After feature engineering; before generating synthetic data.

cards.name: output_formatter1 / FormatOutput
cards.purpose: Checks generated time-series CSV files and produces a validation summary.
cards.use_when: End of the German time-series workflow.

cards.name: topology_generator1 / GenerateTopology
cards.purpose: Generates candidate district-heating network topologies from a run configuration.
cards.use_when: After the run configuration; before rendering the topologies.

cards.name: villas_chronics1 / GenerateChronics
cards.purpose: Generates electricity load and production time series (chronics) with the VILLASnode simulator.
cards.use_when: After grid data has been provided; produces CSV time series.

round_decimals.title: Decimal places
round_decimals.description: Number of decimals in the generated time series.
